ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

No. 2370/33 – SATURDAY, FEBRUARY 10, 2024
EXTRAORDINARY

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: Maha/E/Ath/379. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act on 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following Land / Servitude which are required for a public purpose: Description of the Land or Servitude to be Acquired: The allotments of lands described and depicted as Lot No. 1-3 in Preliminary Plan No. 10057 prepared by the Surveyor General with extent of 0.0327 Ha. Situated in No. 527 Nawinna Grama Niladhari Division in Divisional Secretariat Division of Maharagama in Colombo District in Western Province. 1. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Not known; Description : Drain; Claimant: State; Original Claimant : Claimant not known; Extent: 0.0086 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 02 Name of the land: Not known; Description : Cement Drain; Claimant: State; Original Claimant : Claimant not known; Extent: 0.0021 Hectare. 3. Lot No. 03 Name of the land: Gorakagahadeniya; Description : Waste Land; Claimant: State; Original Claimant : Claimant not known; Extent: 0.0220 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid Land/Servitude are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Maharagama on 04.03.2024 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 29.02.2024 the nature of their interests in the Land/Servitude, the particulars compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. All deeds and other documents in support of the claims should be produced at the inquiry.
M. M. K. Dංඅඋඎ඄ඌඁං Wൺඅඉඈඅൺ, Divisional Secretary, Maharagama.
At Divisional Secretariat of Maharagama, 01st February, 2024.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: ARA/LND/ACQV1/D3/64. Minister of Tourism and Lands Reference No. : 4-3/18/2019/WS/439. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following Land / Servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of Land or Servitude to be acquired: An allotment of land about 0.0502 Hectare in extent is depicted as Lot 01, in cadastral map Number 610388 and dated 21.12.2023 made by the Senior Superintendent of Survey and situated in the village of Habalakkawa, in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 44A, Habalakkawa, in the Galbata Korale, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Aranayaka, in the District of Kegalle, in Sabaragamuwa Province. Boundaries are as follows: 1. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Kobekatuwahena; Extent: 0.0502 Hectare. Boundaries : North : Lot No. 11 and 9 in P. P. K. No. 3734 and Kobekaduwahena are claimed by Manneththiyalage Selavathi and others; East : Lot Nos. 11 and 9 in P. P. K.

No. 3734; South : Aluthdurayalagehena is claimed by M. A. Somawathi and others Kabekaduwahena is claimed by M. Ranasinghe and others; West: Aluthdurayalagehena is claimed by M. A. Somawathi and others, Kabekaduwahena is claimed by M. Ranasinghe and others. Other Particulars : Land has been acquired under Section 38 provision of (A) of the Land Acquisition Act. Manneththiyalage Shamila Disanayaka is a preliminary claimant and resident of B/18/1, Madeliya, Hemmathagama for the completion of acquisition activities. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a Servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka on the 20th day of March 2024 at 10.00 a.m. Further they are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 13th day of March 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and details of the computation of such amount.
Sඁൺආൺඅං Pංඒൺඍඁංඌඌൺ, Divisional Secretary, Aranayaka.
At Divisional Secretariat of Aranayaka, 07th February, 2024.
